title: Extract row_to_message helper in kith-store/message.rs
description:
What: The column-index-based row deserialization for Message is duplicated in get() and list_by_chat() in kith-store/src/message.rs. Extract it into a private fn row_to_message(row: &Row) -> rusqlite::Result<Message>, paralleling the existing row_to_contact() helper.

Algorithm:
1. Read message.rs; find both deserialization blocks in get() and list_by_chat()
2. Write private fn row_to_message(row: &Row<'_>) -> rusqlite::Result<Message>:
   - Extract each column in order: id, chat_id, sender_id, body, sent_at, received_at, delivery_state, state_version, read_at
   - Handle Option fields correctly (read_at, received_at may be NULL)
3. Replace both call sites with row_to_message(row)?
4. Ensure the SELECT column order in both queries matches the row_to_message column indices exactly

Defensive programming rules:
- Column indices in row_to_message must match the SELECT list in BOTH queries — read both SELECT statements before writing the helper
- If the two queries select different column sets, align them first before extracting
- Do not change the SQL queries themselves unless needed to align column order
- Run cargo test -p kith-store after each substitution

Agent team: single R+I+T agent (one file)

Tests:
- cargo test -p kith-store passes with all existing tests unchanged
- cargo clippy -p kith-store -D warnings passes
